title: Audit & Accounts Assistant
description:
REED Practice are actively recruiting for an Audit & Accounts Assistant to join a hugely successful and fast growing Accountancy Practice based in Poole. With a dedicated Audit department (Team of 8) you will be joining a supportive and hands on team.

This is a dynamic practice, offering hybrid working, flexibility and a clear progression route towards ACA / ACCA Qualification. They will also offer study support and will payment towards any refund on clawback clauses. Please see details below:

Audit and Accounts Assistant

Full Time - Hybrid options - Salary £26,000 - £32,000) DOE

Poole based (Parking available)

1 years experience preferred (Accountancy Practice)

Role
- Assist with audit assignments, including testing and preparing working papers.
- Support the preparation of statutory accounts for a range of clients.
- Prepare account reconciliations and supporting schedules.
- Assist with bookkeeping, VAT returns, and basic tax compliance work.
- Communicate with clients to obtain information and resolve queries.
- Ensure work is completed accurately and within deadlines.

Benefits:
- Core hours with flexibility at the beginning and end of the working day
- Career progression
- Free car parking
- Regular team social events
- Referral programme
- Supportive work environment
- Company pension
